new_candidates.notes: This is Sherman Township in Huron County, Michigan (Thumb region), sourced independently in the MI research pass. A parallel event in the Ohio chronology (work/chronology/OH.json), titled 'Sherman Township enacts a 12-month moratorium' and dated 2026-06-03, cites a nearly identical article at https://www.recordpatriot.com/news/article/sherman-township-data-center-moratorium-22322600.php - note the identical trailing article ID '22322600.php' shared with the michigansthumb.com URL cited here. michigansthumb.com and recordpatriot.com are both Hearst Michigan network sites (Thumb/Huron County area and Manistee/Benzie area respectively) that commonly syndicate the same wire content across their shared CMS. Given the identical article ID, near-identical vote description (unanimous/5-0, 12 months, up to 12-month extension), and the fact that no Sherman Township moratorium is otherwise reported in Ohio press, this is judged to be the same underlying Huron County, Michigan story mis-filed into the Ohio notes (recordpatriot.com covers Michigan's Benzie/Manistee area, not Ohio). It is therefore treated as one instrument, not two, and no separate Benzie County or Ohio candidate is created here.
